description: Messages the server pushes are queued as they arrive: a stage that sends nothing takes the oldest that matches from the whole queue, drain discards the rest, and an absent expect then sees none

stages.name: trigger
stages.description: The first stage naming the connection opens it. The server pushes three messages, then replies; the reply carries the send's seq back

stages.name: second push
stages.description: No send, so the whole queue counts: the pushes stayed queued, and the oldest that matches is taken

stages.name: flush
stages.description: Pushes 1 and 3 are still queued: drain discards them, so nothing matches by the deadline
